# I18n Helpers v0.15.0 - Table of Contents

A set of tools to help you translate your Elixir applications

## Pages

- [I18n Helpers](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [I18nHelpers.Ecto.TranslatableFields](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Ecto.TranslatableFields.md): Provides macros for defining translatable fields and associations.
- [I18nHelpers.Ecto.TranslatableType](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Ecto.TranslatableType.md)
- [I18nHelpers.Ecto.Translator](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Ecto.Translator.md)
- [I18nHelpers.HTML.InputHelpers](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.HTML.InputHelpers.md): Provides view helpers to render HTML input fields for text that must be
provided in multiple languages. The multilingual texts passed to the
form (usually in a changeset) are expected to be maps where each key
represents a locale and each value contains the text for that locale.
For example
- [I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromDomain](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromDomain.md): Plug to fetch the locale from the URL's subdomain;
assigns the locale to the Connection and sets the Gettext locale.
- [I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromPath](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromPath.md): Plug to fetch the locale from the first segment of the URL's request path;
assigns the locale to the Connection and sets the Gettext locale.
- [I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromSubdomain](https://i18n-helpers.hexdocs.pm/I18nHelpers.Plugs.PutLocaleFromSubdomain.md): Plug to fetch the locale from the URL's subdomain;
assigns the locale to the Connection and sets the Gettext locale.
